summary.headline: Stellar Configurations in Nativities
summary.text: Astrological delineations of nativity conditions: planetary and stellar configurations produce traits ranging from daring, cruel, and criminal to beautiful, generous, wealthy, famous, and eventually associated with priesthood, divine worship, or dietary abstinence. It identifies fixed stars in the Centaur, River, Leo, and Hydra, their zodiacal degrees, temperaments, and aspects to the Moon, with editorial references to Ptolemy and Athenaeus.
